title: Feature Admission Decision — answers ONLY: may OUR product capability execute?
description: Entitlement axis only. It MUST NOT represent provider auth, provider policy, provider availability, or safety state — those are separate axes composed by DispatchAdmissionDecision. V1.3.1 narrowing: provider/host/runtime/safety outcomes removed.

capability_id.description: Namespaced capability id, e.g. graph.core or orchestration.multi_runtime. Extensible string, never an enum.

outcome.description: Entitlement-axis outcomes only. Provider, host, runtime and safety outcomes are structurally excluded.

dispatch_permitted.description: False guarantees zero provider dispatch and zero authoritative state mutation for this capability on the entitlement axis alone. Final dispatch requires DispatchAdmissionDecision.

activation_state.description: Activation provenance. Distinguishes a fresh Free install from a previously activated install whose entitlement is missing.
